findings.why: Regulating oil is a claim about changing a body process (sebum activity), which sits in the structure/function grey area even with 'helps'. It is page wording but not legal clearance.
findings.fix: Describe the ingredient role without the process claim, for example 'Matmarine: a marine-derived ingredient in the formula', or get legal to accept the page wording.

findings.why: 'Balances sebum activity' is an unhedged body-process claim attributed to an ingredient, also sourced from the page but not cleared.
findings.fix: Remove it, or hedge it to appearance, for example 'With Zinc, for a less shiny look', if legal accepts it.

rule_hit_review.why: On-image text names Niacinamide without its strength on that line; the 10% appears in the headline and body, so this is a minor advisory.

tone_read: Educational and ingredient-led with named suppliers, which suits Minimalist's voice. No fear, hype or emoji.
language_read: The 10% strength appears in the headline, body and product name. Process verbs such as 'regulate' and 'balances' are less hedged than the brand's usual appearance-scoped phrasing.
